name: Gridline
statusNote: Version 0.3.0-g2, the first public build: two timed drills on the laptop and a reference-and-tools Companion on the phone. Drill scores count toward no skill yet.
oneLiner: An unofficial trainer for Canadian topographic map skills. It runs in the browser, keeps each visitor's progress in that browser, and works offline once its pack is installed.
stack: Vite, React and TypeScript, built to static files and served from a subfolder
A hand-written service worker: every precached file is checked by SHA-256 at install, and it deletes only its own caches
Exact rational arithmetic (BigInt) for every marked answer; no floating point decides a mark
node --test and Playwright gates in one chain; the only runtime libraries are React and React DOM

components.name: Drills
components.desc: Scale Sprint (map distance to ground distance and back) and Grid Snap (four- and six-figure grid references on a drawn grid), each a 90-second round.

components.name: Warm-up
components.desc: The same items with no clock and no score; the full worked correction stays on screen after every answer.

components.name: How to read it
components.desc: One page per drill. Each rule shows its source ids; a rule with one source, or not yet checked, also shows its label and the reason.

components.name: Companion
components.desc: The phone surface: a searchable reference, a scale calculator, a grid scratchpad and the source panels. It records no progress.

components.name: Source registry
components.desc: Every source record the build carries, with its class, dates, licence and how it is used. Crown-copyright guides are linked, never copied.

components.name: Offline pack
components.desc: Precache lists per surface, a cache name taken from the content of the build, and an install that fails rather than cache a wrong file.

dataFlow: A seeded generator builds each item and its answer before the item is shown.
The learner answers, and an exact grader marks the answer.
A timed round keeps score and combo; the warm-up shows the worked correction and records nothing.
Round results stay in this browser. In this version, drill scores count toward no skill.
The service worker checks every file of the offline pack by SHA-256 before it serves a single one offline.
integrations: One map extract: NRCan CanTopo 011E03 SHUBENACADIE (2010), cropped only and hash-pinned, under the Open Government Licence – Canada
Rules cite NRCan pages and DND cadet guides by id; the text is paraphrased and the publications are linked, not bundled
decisions: A rule is marked only when two independent sources agree; a point with one source, or not yet checked, is taught with its label and never marked.
Every public string describes the build that shows it, not the plan.
Screen practice is not field practice. The app claims results on a screen and nothing more.
No accounts, no backend, no telemetry: each visitor's progress stays in that visitor's browser.
The page lives in its own folder and its service worker touches only its own caches, so it shares the site's origin safely.
